content:
Apple TV subscribers can now watch all episodes of the new season of Stillwater, an award-winning mindfulness-themed animated series that has debuted on the platform. Watch the trailer below.

All five episodes are now available.

Days after releasing a trailer for the new season of Stillwater, Apple TV today launched all five episodes of the Emmy Award-winning, Zen-inspired series for streaming.

Stillwater is adapted from Jon J Muth's bestselling "Zen" picture book series published by Scholastic. The original premiered in 2020 and has since won a Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Editing for a Preschool Animated Program, as well as a Peabody Award in the Children's/Youth category.
